::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 27.1867.  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (1) P. 45
:::

Dear Miss Yonge	
[*illegible*] the [Chaplet](cmy_books/cmybook_69.qmd) duly arrived. The <u>minimal</u> changes you propose seem to me quite sufficient. Benson will do very well. He was in my young days a popular gentleman on the stage - at least in London which was my only way of hearing about such things.

[I](people/person_939.qmd)will write you about the other matter in a day or to. St John’s seems to me very similar to the earlier one. I had an idea of making a [*illegible*] divine to [*illegible*]. perhaps some division might be well.

Yours very truly
A. Macmillan
